theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 起初，神創造天地。地是空虛混沌，淵面黑暗；神的靈運行在水面上。
en: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 神說：我們要照著我們的形像、按著我們的樣式造人，使他們管理海裡的魚、空中的鳥、地上的牲畜，和全地，並地上所爬的一切昆蟲。
en: Then God said, “Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky, over the livestock and all the wild animals, and over all the creatures that move along the ground.”

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 耶和華阿，眾神之中，誰能像你？誰能像你─至聖至榮，可頌可畏，施行奇事？
en: Who among the gods is like you, Lord? Who is like you— majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, working wonders?

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 我是把你們從埃及地領出來的耶和華，要作你們的神；所以你們要聖潔，因為我是聖潔的。
en: I am the Lord, who brought you up out of Egypt to be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 你們彼此不可虧負，只要敬畏你們的神，因為我是耶和華─你們的神。
en: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God. I am the Lord your God.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 神非人，必不致說謊，也非人子，必不致後悔。他說話豈不照著行呢？他發言豈不要成就呢？
en: God is not human, that he should lie, not a human being, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 又使這眾人知道耶和華使人得勝，不是用刀用槍，因為爭戰的勝敗全在乎耶和華。他必將你們交在我們手裡。
en: All those gathered here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the Lord saves; for the battle is the Lord’s, and he will give all of you into our hands.”

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 耶和華的眼目遍察全地，要顯大能幫助向他心存誠實的人。你這事行得愚昧；此後，你必有爭戰的事。
en: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. You have done a foolish thing, and from now on you will be at war.”

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 你必點著我的燈；耶和華─我的神必照明我的黑暗。
en: You, Lord, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 神啊，我的心切慕你，如鹿切慕溪水。
en: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 神是我們的避難所，是我們的力量，是我們在患難中隨時的幫助。
en: Of the Sons of Korah. According to alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 我的肉體和我的心腸衰殘；但神是我心裡的力量，又是我的福分，直到永遠。
en: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 你要專心仰賴耶和華，不可倚靠自己的聰明，在你一切所行的事上都要認定他，他必指引你的路。
en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 人心籌算自己的道路；惟耶和華指引他的腳步。
en: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 耶和華的名是堅固臺；義人奔入便得安穩。
en: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 耶和華說：我的意念非同你們的意念；我的道路非同你們的道路。天怎樣高過地，照樣，我的道路高過你們的道路；我的意念高過你們的意念。
en: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways,” declares the Lord. “As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 每早晨，這都是新的；你的誠實極其廣大！
en: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 耶和華本為善，在患難的日子為人的保障，並且認得那些投靠他的人。
en: The Lord is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 清心的人有福了！因為他們必得見神。
en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 太初有道，道與神同在，道就是神。這道太初與神同在。萬物是藉著他造的；凡被造的，沒有一樣不是藉著他造的。
en: The Word Became Flesh  In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. He was with God in the beginning. Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，叫一切信他的，不至滅亡，反得永生。
en: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 要叫他們尋求神，或者可以揣摩而得，其實他離我們各人不遠。
en: God did this so that they would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from any one of us.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 神的事情，人所能知道的，原顯明在人心裡，因為神已經給他們顯明。自從造天地以來，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，雖是眼不能見，但藉著所造之物就可以曉得，叫人無可推諉。
en: since what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them. For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities—his eternal power and divine nature—have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made, so that people are without excuse.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 因神的愚拙總比人智慧，神的軟弱總比人強壯。
en: For the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 神能將各樣的恩惠多多的加給你們，使你們凡事常常充足，能多行各樣善事。
en: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 我靠著那加給我力量的，凡事都能做。
en: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 這是好的，在神我們救主面前可蒙悅納。他願意萬人得救，明白真道。
en: This is good, and pleases God our Savior, who wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 聖經都是神所默示的（或作：凡神所默示的聖經），於教訓、督責、使人歸正、教導人學義都是有益的，叫屬神的人得以完全，預備行各樣的善事。
en: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness, so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 人非有信，就不能得神的喜悅；因為到神面前來的人必須信有神，且信他賞賜那尋求他的人。
en: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 親愛的兄弟阿，不要效法惡，只要效法善。行善的屬乎神；行惡的未曾見過神。
en: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.

theme: 一月 耶和華神-聖父
zh: 主神說：我是阿拉法，我是俄梅戛，（阿拉法，俄梅戛：是希利尼字母首末二字），是昔在、今在、以後永在的全能者。
en: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.”

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 因有一嬰孩為我們而生；有一子賜給我們。政權必擔在他的肩頭上；他名稱為奇妙策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君。
en: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 耶穌對他們說：來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。
en: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裡來，我就使你們得安息。
en: “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 我心裡柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裡就必得享安息。因為我的軛是容易的，我的擔子是輕省的。
en: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 耶穌聽見，就對他們說：康健的人用不著醫生，有病的人才用得著。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。
en: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 人子來不是要滅人的性命，是要救人的性命。
en: For the Son of Man did not come to destroy men’s lives but to save them.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 從來沒有人看見神，只有在父懷裡的獨生子將他表明出來。
en: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們叫一切信他的，不至滅亡，反得永生。
en: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 耶穌說：我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意，做成他的工。
en: “My food,” said Jesus, “is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 耶穌對他們說：我實實在在的告訴你們，子憑著自己不能做甚麼，惟有看見父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照樣做。
en: Jesus gave them this answer: “Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 耶穌說：我就是生命的糧。到我這裡來的，必定不餓；信我的，永遠不渴。
en: Then Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊得生命，並且得的更豐盛。
en: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 耶穌說我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。
en: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 神設立耶穌作挽回祭，是憑著耶穌的血，藉著人的信，要顯明神的義；因為他用忍耐的心寬容人先時所犯的罪。
en: God presented Christ as a sacrifice of atonement, through the shedding of his blood—to be received by faith. He did this to demonstrate his righteousness, because in his forbearance he had left the sins committed beforehand unpunished—

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 感謝神，使我們藉著我們的主耶穌基督得勝。
en: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 若有人在基督裡，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。
en: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 願主耶穌基督的恩惠、神的慈愛、聖靈的感動，常與你們眾人同在。
en: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 基督釋放了我們，叫我們得以自由。所以要站立得穩，不要再被奴僕的軛挾制。
en: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 我們原是他的工作，在基督耶穌裡造成的，為要叫我們行善，就是神所預備叫我們行的。
en: For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 我還有末了的話：你們要靠著主，倚賴他的大能大力作剛強的人。要穿戴神所賜的全副軍裝，就能抵擋魔鬼的詭計。
en: The Armor of God Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 弟兄們，我不是以為自己已經得著了；我只有一件事，就是忘記背後，努力面前的，向著標竿直跑，要得神在基督耶穌裡從上面召我來得的獎賞。
en: Brothers and sisters, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 我的神必照他榮耀的豐富，在基督耶穌裡，使你們一切所需用的都充足。
en: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 無論做甚麼，或說話或行事，都要奉主耶穌的名，藉著他感謝父神。
en: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 我們靠主深信，你們現在是遵行我們所吩咐的，後來也必要遵行。願主引導你們的心，叫你們愛神，並學基督的忍耐。
en: We have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do the things we command. May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 基督耶穌降世，為要拯救罪人。這話是可信的，是十分可佩服的。在罪人中我是個罪魁。
en: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—of whom I am the worst.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 因為只有一位神，在神和人中間，只有一位中保，乃是降世為人的基督耶穌。
en: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 仰望為我們信心創始成終的耶穌。他因那擺在前面的喜樂，就輕看羞辱，忍受了十字架的苦難，便坐在神寶座的右邊。
en: fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith. For the joy set before him he endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 耶穌基督，昨日、今日、一直到永遠、是一樣的。
en: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

theme: 二月 耶穌基督-聖子
zh: 神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們叫一切信他的，不至滅亡，反得永生。
en: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

zh: 起初，神創造天地。地是空虛混沌，淵面黑暗；神的靈運行在水面上。
en: The Beginning 1 In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.

zh: 他對我說：這是耶和華指示所羅巴伯的。萬軍之耶和華說：不是倚靠勢力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的靈方能成事。
en: So he said to me, “This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: ‘Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the Lord Almighty.

zh: 神啊，求你為我造清潔的心，使我裡面重新有正直的靈。不要丟棄我，使我離開你的面；不要從我收回你的聖靈。
en: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me. Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

zh: 求你使我仍得救恩之樂，賜我樂意的靈扶持我，
en: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

zh: 耶穌受了洗，隨即從水裡上來。天忽然為他開了，他就看見神的靈彷彿鴿子降下，落在他身上。從天上有聲音說：這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。
en: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water. At that moment heaven was opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and alighting on him. And a voice from heaven said, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.”

zh: 所以我告訴你們：人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都可得赦免，惟獨褻瀆聖靈，總不得赦免。
en: And so I tell you, every kind of sin and slander can be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

zh: 耶穌進前來，對他們說：天上地下所有的權柄都賜給我了。所以，你們要去，使萬民作我的門徒，奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗。
en: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me. Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

zh: 耶穌說：我實實在在的告訴你，人若不是從水和聖靈生的，就不能進神的國。
en: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.

zh: 風隨著意思吹，你聽見風的響聲，卻不曉得從那裡來，往那裡去；凡從聖靈生的，也是如此。
en: The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”

zh: 但保惠師，就是父因我的名所要差來的聖靈，他要將一切的事指教你們，並且要叫你們想起我對你們所說的一切話。
en: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.

zh: 只等真理的聖靈來了，他要引導你們明白一切的真理；因為他不是憑自己說的，乃是把他所聽見的都說出來，並要把將來的事告訴你們。
en: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.

zh: 彼得說：你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈；
en: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

zh: 如果神的靈住在你們心裡，你們就不屬肉體，乃屬聖靈了。人若沒有基督的靈，就不是屬基督的。
en: You, however, are not in the realm of the flesh but are in the realm of the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, they do not belong to Christ.

zh: 然而，叫耶穌從死裡復活者的靈若住在你們心裡，那叫基督耶穌從死裡復活的，也必藉著住在你們心裡的聖靈，使你們必死的身體又活過來。
en: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you.

zh: 況且我們的軟弱有聖靈幫助，我們本不曉得當怎樣禱告，只是聖靈親自用說不出來的歎息替我們禱告。
en: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans.

zh: 鑒察人心的，曉得聖靈的意思，因為聖靈照著神的旨意替聖徒祈求。
en: And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for God’s people in accordance with the will of God.

zh: 我說的話、講的道，不是用智慧委婉的言語，乃是用聖靈和大能的明證，叫你們的信不在乎人的智慧，只在乎神的大能。
en: My message and my preaching were not with wise and persuasive words, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power, so that your faith might not rest on human wisdom, but on God’s power.

zh: 只有神藉著聖靈向我們顯明了，因為聖靈參透萬事，就是神深奧的事也參透了。
en: these are the things God has revealed to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

zh: 我們所領受的，並不是世上的靈，乃是從神來的靈，叫我們能知道神開恩賜給我們的事。
en: What we have received is not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.

zh: 恩賜原有分別，聖靈卻是一位。職事也有分別，主卻是一位。功用也有分別，神卻是一位，在眾人裡面運行一切的事。
en: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit distributes them. There are different kinds of service, but the same Lord. There are different kinds of working, but in all of them and in everyone it is the same God at work.

zh: 聖靈顯在各人身上，是叫人得益處。這人蒙聖靈賜他智慧的言語，那人也蒙這位聖靈賜他知識的言語，又有一人蒙這位聖靈賜他信心，還有一人蒙這位聖靈賜他醫病的恩賜。
en: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good. To one there is given through the Spirit a message of wisdom, to another a message of knowledge by means of the same Spirit, to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,

zh: 又叫一人能行異能，又叫一人能作先知，又叫一人能辨別諸靈，又叫一人能說方言，又叫一人能繙方言。這一切都是這位聖靈所運行、隨己意分給各人的。
en: to another miraculous powers, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in different kinds of tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues. All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he distributes them to each one, just as he determines.

zh: 我們不拘是猶太人，是希利尼人，是為奴的，是自主的，都從一位聖靈受洗，成了一個身體，飲於一位聖靈。
en: For we were all baptized by one Spirit so as to form one body—whether Jews or Gentiles, slave or free—and we were all given the one Spirit to drink.

zh: 主就是那靈；主的靈在那裡，那裡就得以自由。
en: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

zh: 我說，你們當順著聖靈而行，就不放縱肉體的情慾了。因為情慾和聖靈相爭，聖靈和情慾相爭，這兩個是彼此相敵，使你們不能做所願意做的。
en: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh. For the flesh desires what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are in conflict with each other, so that you are not to do whatever you want.

zh: 聖靈所結的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信實、溫柔、節制。這樣的事沒有律法禁止。
en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

zh: 我們若是靠聖靈得生，就當靠聖靈行事。
en: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

zh: 不要銷滅聖靈的感動；不要藐視先知的講論。但要凡事察驗，善美的要持守，各樣的惡事要禁戒不做。
en: Do not quench the Spirit. Do not treat prophecies with contempt but test them all; hold on to what is good, reject every kind of evil.

zh: 你們若為基督的名受辱罵，便是有福的；因為神榮耀的靈常住在你們身上。
en: If you are insulted because of the name of Christ, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

zh: 凡靈認耶穌基督是成了肉身來，就是出於神的；從此你們可以認出神的靈來。
en: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

zh: 神將他的靈賜給我們，從此就知道我們是住在他裡面，他也住在我們裡面。
en: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.

zh: 應當稱謝耶和華；因他本為善，他的慈愛永遠長存！
en: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever.

zh: 主啊，你本為良善，樂意饒恕人，有豐盛的慈愛賜給凡求告你的人。
en: You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you.

zh: 求你使我們早早飽得你的慈愛，好叫我們一生一世歡呼喜樂。
en: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

zh: 耶和華在他一切所行的，無不公義；在他一切所做的都有慈愛。
en: The Lord is righteous in all his ways and faithful in all he does.

zh: 恨能挑啟爭端；愛能遮掩一切過錯。
en: Hatred stirs up conflict, but love covers over all wrongs.

zh: 我們不致消滅，是出於耶和華諸般的慈愛；是因他的憐憫不致斷絕。
en: Because of the Lord’s great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.

zh: 耶穌對他說：你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主─你的神。這是誡命中的第一，且是最大的。其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。
en: Jesus replied: “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’ This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’

zh: 我賜給你們一條新命令，乃是叫你們彼此相愛；我怎樣愛你們，你們也要怎樣相愛。
en: “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.

zh: 你們若有彼此相愛的心，眾人因此就認出你們是我的門徒了。
en: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”

zh: 有了我的命令又遵守的，這人就是愛我的；愛我的必蒙我父愛他，我也要愛他，並且要向他顯現。
en: Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. The one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love them and show myself to them.”

zh: 你們要彼此相愛，像我愛你們一樣；這就是我的命令。
en: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.

zh: 惟有基督在我們還作罪人的時候為我們死，神的愛就在此向我們顯明了。
en: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

zh: 愛人不可虛假；惡要厭惡，善要親近。愛弟兄，要彼此親熱；恭敬人，要彼此推讓。
en: Love in Action Love must be sincere. Hate what is evil; cling to what is good. Be devoted to one another in love. Honor one another above yourselves.

zh: 我若有先知講道之能，也明白各樣的奧祕，各樣的知識，而且有全備的信，叫我能夠移山，卻沒有愛，我就算不得甚麼。
en: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.

zh: 我若將所有的賙濟窮人，又捨己身叫人焚燒，卻沒有愛，仍然與我無益。
en: If I give all I possess to the poor and give over my body to hardship that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.

zh: 愛是恆久忍耐，又有恩慈；愛是不嫉妒；愛是不自誇，不張狂，不做害羞的事，不求自己的益處，不輕易發怒，不計算人的惡。
en: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.

zh: 不喜歡不義，只喜歡真理；凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。愛是永不止息。
en: Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres. Love never fails.

zh: 如今常存的有信，有望，有愛這三樣，其中最大的是愛。
en: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

zh: 你們務要儆醒，在真道上站立得穩，要作大丈夫，要剛強。凡你們所做的都要憑愛心而做。
en: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong. Do everything in love.

zh: 所以，你們既是神的選民，聖潔蒙愛的人，就要存憐憫、恩慈、謙虛、溫柔、忍耐的心。
en: Therefore, as God’s chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

zh: 你們務要常存弟兄相愛的心。不可忘記用愛心接待客旅；因為曾有接待客旅的，不知不覺就接待了天使。
en: Concluding Exhortations 13 Keep on loving one another as brothers and sisters. Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have shown hospitality to angels without knowing it.

zh: 最要緊的是彼此切實相愛，因為愛能遮掩許多的罪。
en: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

zh: 親愛的弟兄阿，我們應當彼此相愛，因為愛是從神來的。凡有愛心的，都是由神而生，並且認識神。沒有愛心的，就不認識神，因為神就是愛。
en: God’s Love and Ours Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

zh: 神差他獨生子到世間來，使我們藉著他得生，神愛我們的心在此就顯明了。
en: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

zh: 不是我們愛神，乃是神愛我們，差他的兒子為我們的罪作了挽回祭，這就是愛了。親愛的弟兄阿，神既是這樣愛我們，我們也當彼此相愛。
en: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins. Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

zh: 從來沒有人見過神，我們若彼此相愛，神就住在我們裡面，愛他的心在我們裡面得以完全了。
en: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.

zh: 神將他的靈賜給我們，從此就知道我們是住在他裡面，他也住在我們裡面。
en: This is how we know that we live in him and he in us: He has given us of his Spirit.

zh: 神愛我們的心，我們也知道也信。神就是愛；住在愛裡面的，就是住在神裡面，神也住在他裡面。
en: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in them.

zh: 這樣，愛在我們裡面得以完全，我們就可以在審判的日子坦然無懼。因為他如何，我們在這世上也如何。
en: This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.

zh: 愛裡沒有懼怕；愛既完全，就把懼怕除去。因為懼怕裡含著刑罰，懼怕的人在愛裡未得完全。
en: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

zh: 神就照著自己的形像造人，乃是照著他的形像造男造女。神就賜福給他們，又對他們說：要生養眾多，遍滿地面，治理這地，也要管理海裡的魚、空中的鳥，和地上各樣行動的活物。
en: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them. God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky and over every living creature that moves on the ground.”

zh: 我們在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，與我們列祖一樣。我們在世的日子如影兒，不能長存
en: We are foreigners and strangers in your sight, as were all our ancestors. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.

zh: 因為，在你那裡有生命的源頭；在你的光中，我們必得見光。願你常施慈愛給認識你的人，常以公義待心裡正直的人。
en: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light. Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

zh: 你使人歸於塵土，說：你們世人要歸回。在你看來，千年如已過的昨日，又如夜間的一更。
en: You turn people back to dust, saying, “Return to dust, you mortals.” A thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.

zh: 我們一生的年日是七十歲，若是強壯可到八十歲；但其中所矜誇的不過是勞苦愁煩，轉眼成空，我們便如飛而去。
en: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

zh: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端；認識至聖者便是聰明。
en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

zh: 口吐真言，永遠堅立；舌說謊話，只存片時。圖謀惡事的，心存詭詐；勸人和睦的，便得喜樂。
en: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment. Deceit is in the hearts of those who plot evil, but those who promote peace have joy.

zh: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看為清潔；惟有耶和華衡量人心。你所做的，要交託耶和華，你所謀的，就必成立。
en: All a person’s ways seem pure to them, but motives are weighed by the Lord. Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

zh: 人心籌算自己的道路；惟耶和華指引他的腳步。
en: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

zh: 驕傲在敗壞以先；狂心在跌倒之前。心裡謙卑與窮乏人來往，強如將擄物與驕傲人同分。
en: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall. Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

zh: 白髮是榮耀的冠冕，在公義的道上必能得著。不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士；治服己心的，強如取城。籤放在懷裡，定事由耶和華。
en: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained in the way of righteousness. Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city. The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord.

zh: 寡少言語的，有知識；性情溫良的，有聰明。愚昧人若靜默不言也可算為智慧；閉口不說也可算為聰明。
en: The one who has knowledge uses words with restraint, and whoever has understanding is even-tempered. Even fools are thought wise if they keep silent, and discerning if they hold their tongues.

zh: 沒有人能以智慧、聰明、謀略敵擋耶和華。馬是為打仗之日預備的；得勝乃在乎耶和華。
en: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the Lord. The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the Lord.

zh: 美名勝過大財；恩寵強如金銀。富戶窮人在世相遇，都為耶和華所造。
en: 22 A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold. Rich and poor have this in common: The Lord is the Maker of them all.

zh: 人一生虛度的日子，就如影兒經過，誰知道甚麼與他有益呢？誰能告訴他身後在日光之下有甚麼事呢？
en: For who knows what is good for a person in life, during the few and meaningless days they pass through like a shadow? Who can tell them what will happen under the sun after they are gone?

zh: 所以我告訴你們，不要為生命憂慮吃甚麼，喝甚麼；為身體憂慮穿甚麼。生命不勝於飲食麼？身體不勝於衣裳麼？
en: Do Not Worry “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?

zh: 你們看那天上的飛鳥，也不種，也不收，也不積蓄在倉裡，你們的天父尚且養活他。你們不比飛鳥貴重得多麼？
en: Look at the birds of the air; they do not sow or reap or store away in barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

zh: 你們要先求他的國和他的義，這些東西都要加給你們了。所以，不要為明天憂慮，因為明天自有明天的憂慮；一天的難處一天當就夠了。
en: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well. Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

zh: 於是叫眾人和門徒來，對他們說：若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我和福音喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
en: The Way of the Cross Then he called the crowd to him along with his disciples and said: “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me. For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.

zh: 人就是賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
en: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?

zh: 掩蓋的事沒有不露出來的；隱藏的事，沒有不被人知道的。
en: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

zh: 耶穌說：你這個人！誰立我作你們斷事的官，給你們分家業呢？於是對眾人說：你們要謹慎自守，免去一切的貪心，因為人的生命不在乎家道豐富。
en: Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?” Then he said to them, “Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; life does not consist in an abundance of possessions.”

zh: 耶穌說我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。
en: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

zh: 我卻不以性命為念，也不看為寶貴，只要行完我的路程，成就我從主耶穌所領受的職事，證明神恩惠的福音。
en: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me—the task of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.

zh: 所以弟兄們，我以神的慈悲勸你們，將身體獻上，當作活祭，是聖潔的，是神所喜悅的；你們如此事奉乃是理所當然的。
en: A Living Sacrifice 12 Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.

zh: 在指望中要喜樂，在患難中要忍耐，禱告要恆切。聖徒缺乏要幫補；客要一味的款待。
en: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer. Share with the Lord’s people who are in need. Practice hospitality.

zh: 要彼此同心；不要志氣高大，倒要俯就卑微的人,不要自以為聰明。
en: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but be willing to associate with people of low position. Do not be conceited.

zh: 若有人在基督裡，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。
en: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

zh: 那美好的仗我已經打過了，當跑的路我已經跑盡了，所信的道我已經守住了。從此以後，有公義的冠冕為我存留，就是按著公義審判的主到了那日要賜給我的；不但賜給我，也賜給凡愛慕他顯現的人。
en: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith. Now there is in store for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but also to all who have longed for his appearing.

zh: 各樣美善的恩賜和各樣全備的賞賜都是從上頭來的，從眾光之父那裡降下來的；在他並沒有改變，也沒有轉動的影兒。
en: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

zh: 這世界和其上的情慾都要過去，惟獨遵行神旨意的，是永遠常存。
en: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.

zh: 求你攔阻僕人不犯任意妄為的罪，不容這罪轄制我，我便完全，免犯大罪。
en: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, innocent of great transgression.

zh: 求你不要記念我幼年的罪愆和我的過犯；耶和華啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈愛記念我。
en: Do not remember the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you, Lord, are good.

zh: 我向你陳明我的罪，不隱瞞我的惡。我說：我要向耶和華承認我的過犯，你就赦免我的罪惡。
en: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the Lord.” And you forgave the guilt of my sin.

zh: 我曾說：我要謹慎我的言行，免得我舌頭犯罪；惡人在我面前的時候，我要用嚼環勒住我的口。
en: Psalm 39 For the director of music. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth while in the presence of the wicked.”

zh: 神啊，求你按你的慈愛憐恤我！按你豐盛的慈悲塗抹我的過犯！求你將我的罪孽洗除淨盡，並潔除我的罪！
en: Psalm 51 For the director of music. A psalm of David. When the prophet Nathan came to him after David had committed adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions. Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin. For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

zh: 你將我們的罪孽擺在你面前，將我們的隱惡擺在你面光之中。
en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

zh: 愚妄人的思念乃是罪惡；褻慢者為人所憎惡。
en: The schemes of folly are sin, and people detest a mocker.

zh: 我塗抹了你的過犯，像厚雲消散；我塗抹了你的罪惡，如薄雲滅沒。你當歸向我，因我救贖了你。
en: I have swept away your offenses like a cloud, your sins like the morning mist. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.”

zh: 我們都如羊走迷；各人偏行己路；耶和華使我們眾人的罪孽都歸在他身上。
en: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

zh: 神啊，有何神像你，赦免罪孽，饒恕你產業之餘民的罪過，不永遠懷怒，喜愛施恩？
en: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.

zh: 所以我告訴你們：人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都可得赦免，惟獨褻瀆聖靈，總不得赦免。
en: And so I tell you, every kind of sin and slander can be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

zh: 約翰下監以後, 耶穌來到加利利，宣傳神的福音,說：日期滿了，神的國近了。你們當悔改，信福音！
en: Jesus Announces the Good News After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God. “The time has come,” he said. “The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!”

zh: 耶穌對他們說：無病的人用不著醫生；有病的人才用得著。我來本不是召義人悔改，乃是召罪人悔改。
en: Jesus answered them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

zh: 我告訴你們，一個罪人悔改，在天上也要這樣為他歡喜，較比為九十九個不用悔改的義人歡喜更大。
en: I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.

zh: 耶穌回答說：我實實在在的告訴你們，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴僕。
en: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.

zh: 彼得說：你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈。
en: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

zh: 所以，你們當悔改歸正，使你們的罪得以塗抹，這樣，那安舒的日子就必從主面前來到。
en: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,

zh: 你這論斷人的，無論你是誰，也無可推諉。你在甚麼事上論斷人，就在甚麼事上定自己的罪；因你這論斷人的，自己所行卻和別人一樣。
en: God’s Righteous Judgment 2 You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on someone else, for at whatever point you judge another, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.

zh: 因為世人都犯了罪，虧缺了神的榮耀；
en: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,

zh: 你們要醒悟為善，不要犯罪，因為有人不認識神。我說這話是要叫你們羞愧。
en: Come back to your senses as you ought, and stop sinning; for there are some who are ignorant of God—I say this to your shame.

zh: 像這樣，基督既然一次被獻，擔當了多人的罪，將來要向那等候他的人第二次顯現，並與罪無關，乃是為拯救他們。
en: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

zh: 經上記著說：「要愛人如己。」你們若全守這至尊的律法，才是好的。但你們若按外貌待人，便是犯罪，被律法定為犯法的。
en: If you really keep the royal law found in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing right. But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as lawbreakers.

zh: 人若知道行善，卻不去行，這就是他的罪了。
en: If anyone, then, knows the good they ought to do and doesn’t do it, it is sin for them.

zh: 我的弟兄們，你們中間若有失迷真道的，有人使他回轉，這人該知道：叫一個罪人從迷路上轉回便是救一個靈魂不死，並且遮蓋許多的罪。
en: My brothers and sisters, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring that person back, remember this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of their way will save them from death and cover over a multitude of sins.

zh: 萬物的結局近了。所以，你們要謹慎自守，儆醒禱告。最要緊的是彼此切實相愛，因為愛能遮掩許多的罪。
en: The end of all things is near. Therefore be alert and of sober mind so that you may pray. 8 Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

zh: 主所應許的尚未成就，有人以為他是耽延，其實不是耽延，乃是寬容你們，不願有一人沉淪，乃願人人都悔改。
en: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.

zh: 我們若在光明中行，如同神在光明中，就彼此相交，他兒子耶穌的血也洗淨我們一切的罪。我們若說自己無罪，便是自欺，真理不在我們心裡了。
en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin. If we claim to be without sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

zh: 我們若認自己的罪，神是信實的，是公義的，必要赦免我們的罪，洗淨我們一切的不義。我們若說自己沒有犯過罪，便是以神為說謊的，他的道也不在我們心裡了
en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness. If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.

zh: 凡犯罪的，就是違背律法；違背律法就是罪。
en: Everyone who sins breaks the law; in fact, sin is lawlessness.

zh: 凡我所疼愛的，我就責備管教他；所以你要發熱心，也要悔改。
en: Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest and repent.

zh: 所以，你要知道耶和華─你的神，他是神，是信實的神；向愛他、守他誡命的人守約，施慈愛，直到千代。
en: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commandments.

zh: 耶和華啊，誰能寄居你的帳幕？誰能住在你的聖山？就是行為正直、做事公義、心裡說實話的人。
en: Psalm 15 A psalm of David. Lord, who may dwell in your sacred tent? Who may live on your holy mountain? The one whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from their heart;

zh: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛上及諸天；你的信實達到穹蒼。
en: Your love, Lord, reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.

zh: 我要歌唱耶和華的慈愛，直到永遠；我要用口將你的信實傳與萬代。因我曾說：你的慈悲必建立到永遠；你的信實必堅立在天上。
en: I will sing of the Lord’s great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations. I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

zh: 耶和華啊，諸天要稱讚你的奇事；在聖者的會中，要稱讚你的信實。
en: The heavens praise your wonders, Lord, your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

zh: 耶和華─萬軍之神啊，哪一個大能者像你耶和華？你的信實是在你的四圍。
en: Who is like you, Lord God Almighty? You, Lord, are mighty, and your faithfulness surrounds you.

zh: 你的誠實存到萬代；你堅定了地，地就長存。天地照你的安排存到今日；萬物都是你的僕役。
en: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures. Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.

zh: 有施散的，卻更增添；有吝惜過度的，反致窮乏。好施捨的，必得豐裕；滋潤人的，必得滋潤。
en: One person gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty. A generous person will prosper; whoever refreshes others will be refreshed.

zh: 圖謀惡事的，心存詭詐；勸人和睦的，便得喜樂。
en: Deceit is in the hearts of those who plot evil, but those who promote peace have joy.

zh: 設筵滿屋，大家相爭，不如有塊乾餅，大家相安。
en: 17 Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting, with strife.

zh: 你心若向飢餓的人發憐憫，使困苦的人得滿足，你的光就必在黑暗中發現；你的幽暗必變如正午。
en: and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.

zh: 平安的路，他們不知道；所行的事沒有公平。他們為自己修彎曲的路；凡行此路的都不知道平安。
en: The way of peace they do not know; there is no justice in their paths. They have turned them into crooked roads; no one who walks along them will know peace.

zh: 每早晨，這都是新的；你的誠實極其廣大！我心裡說：耶和華是我的分，因此，我要仰望他。
en: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness. I say to myself, “The Lord is my portion; therefore I will wait for him.”

zh: 使人和睦的人有福了！因為他們必稱為神的兒子。
en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

zh: 那落在好土裡的，就是人聽了道，持守在誠實善良的心裡，並且忍耐著結實。
en: But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.

zh: 時候將到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心靈和誠實拜他，因為父要這樣的人拜他。神是個靈，所以拜他的必須用心靈和誠實拜他。
en: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks. God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”

zh: 耶穌說：我不是對你說過，你若信，就必看見神的榮耀麼？
en: Then Jesus said, “Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”

zh: 我們既因信稱義，就藉著我們的主耶穌基督得與神相和。我們又藉著他，因信得進入現在所站的這恩典中，並且歡歡喜喜盼望神的榮耀。
en: Peace and Hope 5 Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we boast in the hope of the glory of God.

zh: 不要以惡報惡；眾人以為美的事要留心去做。若是能行，總要盡力與眾人和睦。
en: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everyone. If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

zh: 我們所誇的是自己的良心，見證我們憑著神的聖潔和誠實；在世為人不靠人的聰明，乃靠神的恩惠，向你們更是這樣。
en: Paul’s Change of Plans Now this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in our relations with you, with integrity and godly sincerity. We have done so, relying not on worldly wisdom but on God’s grace.

zh: 若有人在基督裡，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。一切都是出於神；他藉著基督使我們與他和好，又將勸人與他和好的職分賜給我們。
en: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here! All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

zh: 因他使我們和睦，將兩下合而為一，拆毀了中間隔斷的牆；而且以自己的身體廢掉冤仇，就是那記在律法上的規條，為要將兩下藉著自己造成一個新人，如此便成就了和睦。
en: Read the Bible Study Tools Bible Gateway Plus Bible News Explore More Store

zh: 凡事謙虛、溫柔、忍耐，用愛心互相寬容，用和平彼此聯絡，竭力保守聖靈所賜合而為一的心。
en: Be completely humble and gentle; be patient, bearing with one another in love. Make every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

zh: 所以你們要棄絕謊言，各人與鄰舍說實話，因為我們是互相為肢體。生氣卻不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，也不可給魔鬼留地步。
en: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor, for we are all members of one body. “In your anger do not sin”: Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry,

zh: 你們的言語要常常帶著和氣，好像用鹽調和，就可知道該怎樣回答各人。
en: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.

zh: 你自己凡事要顯出善行的榜樣；在教訓上要正直、端莊，言語純全，無可指責，叫那反對的人，既無處可說我們的不是，便自覺羞愧。
en: In everything set them an example by doing what is good. In your teaching show integrity, seriousness and soundness of speech that cannot be condemned, so that those who oppose you may be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about us.

zh: 人非有信，就不能得神的喜悅；因為到神面前來的人必須信有神，且信他賞賜那尋求他的人。
en: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

zh: 你們要追求與眾人和睦，並要追求聖潔；非聖潔沒有人能見主。
en: Warning and Encouragement Make every effort to live in peace with everyone and to be holy; without holiness no one will see the Lord.

zh: 我親愛的弟兄們，這是你們所知道的，但你們各人要快快的聽，慢慢的說，慢慢的動怒，因為人的怒氣並不成就神的義。
en: Listening and Doing My dear brothers and sisters, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry, because human anger does not produce the righteousness that God desires.

zh: 惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。
en: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere. Peacemakers who sow in peace reap a harvest of righteousness.

zh: 我們遵守神的誡命，這就是愛他了，並且他的誡命不是難守的。因為凡從神生的，就勝過世界；使我們勝了世界的，就是我們的信心。
en: In fact, this is love for God: to keep his commands. And his commands are not burdensome, for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

zh: 他苦煉你，任你飢餓，將你和你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，使你知道，人活著不是單靠食物，乃是靠耶和華口裡所出的一切話。
en: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your ancestors had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord.

zh: 這稱為我名下的子民，若是自卑、禱告，尋求我的面，轉離他們的惡行，我必從天上垂聽，赦免他們的罪，醫治他們的地。
en: if my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.

zh: 因為耶和華喜愛他的百姓；他要用救恩當作謙卑人的妝飾。
en: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.

zh: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的訓誨；尊榮以前，必有謙卑。
en: Wisdom’s instruction is to fear the Lord, and humility comes before honor.

zh: 敗壞之先，人心驕傲；尊榮以前，必有謙卑。未曾聽完先回答的，便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
en: Before a downfall the heart is haughty, but humility comes before honor. To answer before listening— that is folly and shame.

zh: 美名勝過大財；恩寵強如金銀。富戶窮人在世相遇，都為耶和華所造。通達人見禍藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。敬畏耶和華心存謙卑，就得富有、尊榮、生命為賞賜。
en: 22 A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold. Rich and poor have this in common: The Lord is the Maker of them all. The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty. Humility is the fear of the Lord; its wages are riches and honor and life.

zh: 人的高傲必使他卑下；心裡謙遜的，必得尊榮。
en: Pride brings a person low, but the lowly in spirit gain honor.

zh: 因為那至高至上、永遠長存、名為聖者的如此說：我住在至高至聖的所在，也與心靈痛悔謙卑的人同居；要使謙卑人的靈甦醒，也使痛悔人的心甦醒。
en: For this is what the high and exalted One says— he who lives forever, whose name is holy: “I live in a high and holy place, but also with the one who is contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the contrite.

zh: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裡來，我就使你們得安息。我心裡柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裡就必得享安息。因為我的軛是容易的，我的擔子是輕省的。
en: “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”

zh: 當時，門徒進前來，問耶穌說：天國裡誰是最大的？耶穌便叫一個小孩子來，使他站在他們當中,說：我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成小孩子的樣式，斷不得進天國。所以，凡自己謙卑像這小孩子的，他在天國裡就是最大的。
en: The Greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven 18 At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who, then, is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?” He called a little child to him, and placed the child among them. And he said: “Truly I tell you, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven. Therefore, whoever takes the lowly position of this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

zh: 我告訴你們，這人回家去比那人倒算為義了；因為，凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。
en: “I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”

zh: 不但如此，就是在患難中也是歡歡喜喜的；因為知道患難生忍耐，忍耐生老練，老練生盼望。
en: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.

zh: 我們得救是在乎盼望；只是所見的盼望不是盼望，誰還盼望他所見的呢？但我們若盼望那所不見的，就必忍耐等候。
en: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what they already have? But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.

zh: 從前所寫的聖經都是為教訓我們寫的，叫我們因聖經所生的忍耐和安慰可以得著盼望。但願賜忍耐安慰的神叫你們彼此同心，效法基督耶穌。
en: For everything that was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through the endurance taught in the Scriptures and the encouragement they provide we might have hope. May the God who gives endurance and encouragement give you the same attitude of mind toward each other that Christ Jesus had,

zh: 所以，自己以為站得穩的，須要謹慎，免得跌倒。你們所遇見的試探，無非是人所能受的。神是信實的，必不叫你們受試探過於所能受的；在受試探的時候，總要給你們開一條出路，叫你們能忍受得住。
en: So, if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you don’t fall! No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.

zh: 我在你們中間，用百般的忍耐，藉著神蹟、奇事、異能，顯出使徒的憑據來。
en: I persevered in demonstrating among you the marks of a true apostle, including signs, wonders and miracles.

zh: 凡事謙虛、溫柔、忍耐，用愛心互相寬容，用和平彼此聯絡，竭力保守聖靈所賜合而為一的心。
en: Be completely humble and gentle; be patient, bearing with one another in love. Make every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.

zh: 只是我先前以為與我有益的，我現在因基督都當作有損的。不但如此，我也將萬事當作有損的，因我以認識我主基督耶穌為至寶。我為他已經丟棄萬事，看作糞土，為要得著基督。
en: But whatever were gains to me I now consider loss for the sake of Christ. What is more, I consider everything a loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have lost all things. I consider them garbage, that I may gain Christ and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ—the righteousness that comes from God on the basis of faith.

zh: 弟兄們，我不是以為自己已經得著了；我只有一件事，就是忘記背後，努力面前的，向著標竿直跑，要得神在基督耶穌裡從上面召我來得的獎賞。
en: Brothers and sisters, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.

zh: 當叫眾人知道你們謙讓的心。主已經近了。
en: Let your gentleness be evident to all. The Lord is near.

zh: 好叫你們行事為人對得起主，凡事蒙他喜悅，在一切善事上結果子，漸漸的多知道神；照他榮耀的權能，得以在各樣的力上加力，好叫你們凡事歡歡喜喜的忍耐寬容。
en: so that you may live a life worthy of the Lord and please him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God, being strengthened with all power according to his glorious might so that you may have great endurance and patience,

zh: 所以，你們既是神的選民，聖潔蒙愛的人，就要存憐憫、恩慈、謙虛、溫柔、忍耐的心。倘若這人與那人有嫌隙，總要彼此包容，彼此饒恕；主怎樣饒恕了你們，你們也要怎樣饒恕人
en: Therefore, as God’s chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience. Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

zh: 願主引導你們的心，叫你們愛神，並學基督的忍耐。
en: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

zh: 勸老年人要有節制、端莊、自守，在信心、愛心、忍耐上都要純全無疵。
en: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.

zh: 我的弟兄們，你們落在百般試煉中，都要以為大喜樂;因為知道你們的信心經過試驗，就生忍耐。但忍耐也當成功，使你們成全、完備，毫無缺欠。
en: Trials and Temptations Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance. Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

zh: 卑微的弟兄升高，就該喜樂；富足的降卑，也該如此；因為他必要過去，如同草上的花一樣。太陽出來，熱風颳起，草就枯乾，花也凋謝，美容就消沒了；那富足的人，在他所行的事上也要這樣衰殘。
en: Believers in humble circumstances ought to take pride in their high position. But the rich should take pride in their humiliation—since they will pass away like a wild flower. For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its blossom falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich will fade away even while they go about their business.

zh: 但他賜更多的恩典，所以經上說：神阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。
en: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: “God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.”

zh: 務要在主面前自卑，主就必叫你們升高。
en: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

zh: 弟兄們哪，你們要忍耐，直到主來。看哪，農夫忍耐等候地裡寶貴的出產，直到得了秋雨春雨。你們也當忍耐，堅固你們的心，因為主來的日子近了。
en: Patience in Suffering Be patient, then, brothers and sisters, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop, patiently waiting for the autumn and spring rains. You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.

zh: 倘若人為叫良心對得住神，就忍受冤屈的苦楚，這是可喜愛的。你們若因犯罪受責打，能忍耐，有甚麼可誇的呢？但你們若因行善受苦，能忍耐，這在神看是可喜愛的。
en: For it is commendable if someone bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because they are conscious of God. But how is it to your credit if you receive a beating for doing wrong and endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

zh: 你們年幼的，也要順服年長的。就是你們眾人也都要以謙卑束腰，彼此順服；因為神阻擋驕傲的人，賜恩給謙卑的人。所以，你們要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了時候他必叫你們升高。
en: In the same way, you who are younger, submit yourselves to your elders. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.” Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

zh: 有尊榮和威嚴在他面前,有能力和喜樂在他聖所。
en: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy are in his dwelling place.

zh: 你豈不知亙古以來，自從人生在地，惡人誇勝是暫時的，不敬虔人的喜樂不過轉眼之間麼？
en: “Surely you know how it has been from of old, ever since mankind was placed on the earth, that the mirth of the wicked is brief, the joy of the godless lasts but a moment.

zh: 你要認識神，就得平安；福氣也必臨到你。
en: “Submit to God and be at peace with him; in this way prosperity will come to you.

zh: 你必將生命的道路指示我。在你面前有滿足的喜樂；在你右手中有永遠的福樂。
en: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

zh: 求你使我們早早飽得你的慈愛，好叫我們一生一世歡呼喜樂。
en: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

zh: 散布亮光是為義人；預備喜樂是為正直人。你們義人當靠耶和華歡喜，稱謝他可記念的聖名。
en: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart. Rejoice in the Lord, you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.

zh: 圖謀惡事的，心存詭詐；勸人和睦的，便得喜樂。
en: Deceit is in the hearts of those who plot evil, but those who promote peace have joy.

zh: 人心憂慮，屈而不伸；一句良言，使心歡樂。
en: Anxiety weighs down the heart, but a kind word cheers it up.

zh: 智慧子使父親喜樂；愚昧人藐視母親。
en: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.

zh: 喜樂的心乃是良藥；憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。
en: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

zh: 義人增多，民就喜樂；惡人掌權，民就歎息。
en: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.

zh: 神賜人資財豐富，使他能以吃用，能取自己的分，在他勞碌中喜樂，這乃是神的恩賜。他不多思念自己一生的年日，因為神應他的心使他喜樂。
en: Moreover, when God gives someone wealth and possessions, and the ability to enjoy them, to accept their lot and be happy in their toil—this is a gift of God. They seldom reflect on the days of their life, because God keeps them occupied with gladness of heart.

zh: 堅心倚賴你的，你必保守他十分平安，因為他倚靠你。你們當倚靠耶和華直到永遠，因為耶和華是永久的磐石。
en: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you. Trust in the Lord forever, for the Lord, the Lord himself, is the Rock eternal.

zh: 哪知他為我們的過犯受害，為我們的罪孽壓傷。因他受的刑罰，我們得平安；因他受的鞭傷，我們得醫治。
en: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.

zh: 耶和華說：我知道我向你們所懷的意念是賜平安的意念，不是降災禍的意念，要叫你們末後有指望。
en: For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

zh: 我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裡不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。
en: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

zh: 向來你們沒有奉我的名求甚麼，如今你們求，就必得著，叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
en: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.

zh: 我將這些事告訴你們，是要叫你們在我裡面有平安。在世上，你們有苦難；但你們可以放心，我已經勝了世界。
en: “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”

zh: 我們既因信稱義，就藉著我們的主耶穌基督得與神相和。我們又藉著他，因信得進入現在所站的這恩典中，並且歡歡喜喜盼望神的榮耀。
en: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we boast in the hope of the glory of God.

zh: 在指望中要喜樂，在患難中要忍耐，禱告要恆切。聖徒缺乏要幫補；客要一味的款待。逼迫你們的，要給他們祝福；只要祝福，不可咒詛。與喜樂的人要同樂；與哀哭的人要同哭。
en: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer. Share with the Lord’s people who are in need. Practice hospitality. Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse. Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.

zh: 因為神的國不在乎吃喝，只在乎公義、和平，並聖靈中的喜樂。
en: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit,

zh: 但願使人有盼望的神，因信將諸般的喜樂、平安充滿你們的心，使你們藉著聖靈的能力大有盼望。
en: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

zh: 我為基督的緣故，就以軟弱、凌辱、急難、逼迫、困苦為可喜樂的；因我甚麼時候軟弱，甚麼時候就剛強了。
en: That is why, for Christ’s sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

zh: 我以你們的信心為供獻的祭物，我若被澆奠在其上，也是喜樂，並且與你們眾人一同喜樂。你們也要照樣喜樂，並且與我一同喜樂。
en: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service coming from your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you. So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.

zh: 你們要靠主常常喜樂。我再說，你們要喜樂。當叫眾人知道你們謙讓的心。主已經近了。
en: Final Exhortations Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice! Let your gentleness be evident to all. The Lord is near.

zh: 應當一無罣慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。神所賜出人意外的平安必在基督耶穌裡保守你們的心懷意念。
en: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

zh: 又要叫基督的平安在你們心裡作主；你們也為此蒙召，歸為一體；且要存感謝的心。
en: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.

zh: 要常常喜樂，不住的禱告，凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裡向你們所定的旨意。
en: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

zh: 凡管教的事，當時不覺得快樂，反覺得愁苦；後來卻為那經練過的人結出平安的果子，就是義。
en: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.

zh: 我的弟兄們，你們落在百般試煉中，都要以為大喜樂；因為知道你們的信心經過試驗，就生忍耐。但忍耐也當成功，使你們成全、完備，毫無缺欠。
en: Trials and Temptations Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance. Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

zh: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力，時常尋求他的面。
en: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

zh: 我若心裡注重罪孽，主必不聽。但神實在聽見了；他側耳聽了我禱告的聲音。神是應當稱頌的！他並沒有推卻我的禱告，也沒有叫他的慈愛離開我。
en: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened; but God has surely listened and has heard my prayer. Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!

zh: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔誠人。我的神啊，求你拯救這倚靠你的僕人。主啊，求你憐憫我，因我終日求告你。
en: Guard my life, for I am faithful to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God; have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

zh: 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，垂聽我懇求的聲音。我在患難之日要求告你，因為你必應允我。
en: Hear my prayer, Lord; listen to my cry for mercy. When I am in distress, I call to you, because you answer me.

zh: 他若求告我，我就應允他；他在急難中，我要與他同在；我要搭救他，使他尊貴。我要使他足享長壽，將我的救恩顯明給他。
en: He will call on me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him. With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation.”

zh: 求你使我清晨得聽你慈愛之言，因我倚靠你；求你使我知道當行的路，因我的心仰望你。
en: Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I entrust my life.

zh: 凡求告耶和華的，就是誠心求告他的，耶和華便與他們相近。
en: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

zh: 你們要呼求我，禱告我，我就應允你們。
en: Then you will call on me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

zh: 你們禱告的時候，不可像那假冒為善的人，愛站在會堂裡和十字路口上禱告，故意叫人看見。我實在告訴你們，他們已經得了他們的賞賜。
en: Prayer “And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward in full.

zh: 你禱告的時候，要進你的內屋，關上門，禱告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。
en: But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

zh: 你們禱告，不可像外邦人，用許多重複話，他們以為話多了必蒙垂聽。你們不可效法他們；因為你們沒有祈求以先，你們所需用的，你們的父早已知道了。
en: And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words. Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.

zh: 所以，你們禱告要這樣說：我們在天上的父：願人都尊你的名為聖。願你的國降臨；願你的旨意行在地上，如同行在天上。我們日用的飲食，今日賜給我們。免我們的債，如同我們免了人的債。不叫我們遇見試探；救我們脫離兇惡。因為國度、權柄、榮耀，全是你的，直到永遠。阿們。
en: “This, then, is how you should pray: “‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us today our daily bread. And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’

zh: 你們祈求，就給你們；尋找，就尋見；叩門，就給你們開門。因為凡祈求的，就得著；尋找的，就尋見；叩門的，就給他開門。
en: Ask, Seek, Knock “Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

zh: 我又告訴你們，若是你們中間有兩個人在地上同心合意的求甚麼事，我在天上的父必為他們成全。因為無論在那裡，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裡就有我在他們中間。
en: “Again, truly I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask for, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven. For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.”

zh: 你們禱告，無論求甚麼，只要信，就必得著。
en: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”

zh: 總要儆醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。
en: “Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

zh: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信是得著的，就必得著。
en: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

zh: 你們站著禱告的時候，若想起有人得罪你們，就當饒恕他，好叫你們在天上的父也饒恕你們的過犯。你們若不饒恕人，你們在天上的父也不饒恕你們的過犯。
en: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins.”

zh: 眾百姓都受了洗，耶穌也受了洗。正禱告的時候，天就開了，聖靈降臨在他身上，形狀彷彿鴿子；又有聲音從天上來，說：你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。
en: The Baptism and Genealogy of Jesus When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”

zh: 你們中間作父親的，誰有兒子求餅，反給他石頭呢？求魚，反拿蛇當魚給他呢？求雞蛋，反給他蠍子呢？你們雖然不好，尚且知道拿好東西給兒女；何況天父，豈不更將聖靈給求他的人麼？
en: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead? Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion? If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!”

zh: 耶穌設一個比喻，是要人常常禱告，不可灰心。
en: The Parable of the Persistent Widow 18 Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.

zh: 你們奉我的名無論求甚麼，我必成就，叫父因兒子得榮耀。你們若奉我的名求甚麼，我必成就。
en: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son. You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.

zh: 應當一無罣慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。神所賜出人意外的平安，必在基督耶穌裡保守你們的心懷意念。
en: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

zh: 你們要恆切禱告，在此儆醒感恩。也要為我們禱告，求神給我們開傳道的門，能以講基督的奧祕。
en: Further Instructions Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful. And pray for us, too, that God may open a door for our message, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

zh: 要常常喜樂，不住的禱告，凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裡向你們所定的旨意。
en: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

zh: 我勸你，第一要為萬人懇求、禱告、代求、祝謝；為君王和一切在位的，也該如此，使我們可以敬虔、端正、平安無事的度日。
en: Instructions on Worship 2 I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people— for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.

zh: 你們求也得不著，是因為你們妄求，要浪費在你們的宴樂中。
en: When you ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may spend what you get on your pleasures.

zh: 你們中間有受苦的呢，他就該禱告；有喜樂的呢，他就該歌頌。你們中間有病了的呢，他就該請教會的長老來；他們可以奉主的名用油抹他，為他禱告。
en: The Prayer of Faith Is anyone among you in trouble? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing songs of praise. Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them and anoint them with oil in the name of the Lord.

zh: 出於信心的祈禱要救那病人，主必叫他起來；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。所以你們要彼此認罪，互相代求，使你們可以得醫治。義人祈禱所發的力量是大有功效的。
en: And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven. Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.

zh: 並且我們一切所求的，就從他得著；因為我們遵守他的命令，行他所喜悅的事。
en: and receive from him anything we ask, because we keep his commands and do what pleases him.

zh: 我們若照他的旨意求甚麼，他就聽我們，這是我們向他所存坦然無懼的心。既然知道他聽我們一切所求的，就知道我們所求於他的，無不得著。
en: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us. And if we know that he hears us—whatever we ask—we know that we have what we asked of him.

zh: 耶和華啊，尊大、能力、榮耀、強勝、威嚴都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；國度也是你的，並且你為至高，為萬有之首。豐富尊榮都從你而來，你也治理萬物。在你手裡有大能大力，使人尊大強盛都出於你。我們的神啊，現在我們稱謝你，讚美你榮耀之名。
en: Yours, Lord, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, Lord, is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all. Wealth and honor come from you; you are the ruler of all things. In your hands are strength and power to exalt and give strength to all. Now, our God, we give you thanks, and praise your glorious name.

zh: 但那等候耶和華的必從新得力。他們必如鷹展翅上騰；他們奔跑卻不困倦，行走卻不疲乏。
en: but those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

zh: 耶和華啊，願你因自己的能力顯為至高！這樣，我們就唱詩，歌頌你的大能。
en: Be exalted in your strength, Lord; we will sing and praise your might.

zh: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，因為他聽了我懇求的聲音。耶和華是我的力量，是我的盾牌；我心裡倚靠他就得幫助。所以我心中歡樂，我必用詩歌頌讚他。
en: Read the Bible Study Tools Bible Gateway Plus Bible News Explore More Store

zh: 義人哪，你們應當靠耶和華歡樂；正直人的讚美是合宜的。你們應當彈琴稱謝耶和華，用十弦瑟歌頌他。應當向他唱新歌，彈得巧妙，聲音洪亮。
en: Sing joyfully to the Lord, you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him. Praise the Lord with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre. Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.

zh: 我的舌頭要終日論說你的公義，時常讚美你。
en: My tongue will proclaim your righteousness, your praises all day long.

zh: 我們終日因神誇耀，還要永遠稱謝你的名。
en: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever.

zh: 我從出母胎被你扶持；使我出母腹的是你。我必常常讚美你。
en: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother’s womb. I will ever praise you.

zh: 耶和華啊，諸天要稱讚你的奇事；在聖者的會中，要稱讚你的信實。
en: The heavens praise your wonders, Lord, your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

zh: 我要以感謝為祭獻給你，又要求告耶和華的名。我要在他眾民面前，在耶和華殿的院內，在耶路撒冷當中，向耶和華還我的願。你們要讚美耶和華。
en: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the Lord. I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people, in the courts of the house of the Lord— in your midst, Jerusalem. Praise the Lord.

zh: 我因你公義的典章，半夜必起來稱謝你。
en: Read the Bible Study Tools Bible Gateway Plus Bible News Explore More Store

zh: 我因你公義的典章一天七次讚美你。
en: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.

zh: 我要稱謝你，因我受造，奇妙可畏；你的作為奇妙，這是我心深知道的。
en: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

zh: 義人必要稱讚你的名；正直人必住在你面前。
en: Surely the righteous will praise your name, and the upright will live in your presence.

zh: 我要天天稱頌你，也要永永遠遠讚美你的名！耶和華本為大，該受大讚美；其大無法測度。這代要對那代頌讚你的作為，也要傳揚你的大能。
en: Every day I will praise you and extol your name for ever and ever. Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom. One generation commends your works to another; they tell of your mighty acts.

zh: 你們要讚美耶和華！我的心哪，你要讚美耶和華！我一生要讚美耶和華！我還活的時候要歌頌我的神。
en: Psalm 146 Praise the Lord. Praise the Lord, my soul. I will praise the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

zh: 我列祖的神啊，我感謝你，讚美你，因你將智慧才能賜給我，允准我們所求的，把王的事給我們指明。
en: I thank and praise you, God of my ancestors: You have given me wisdom and power, you have made known to me what we asked of you, you have made known to us the dream of the king.”

zh: 那時，耶穌說：父阿，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。父阿，是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
en: The Father Revealed in the Son At that time Jesus said, “I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.

zh: 祝謝了，就擘開，說：這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。;飯後，也照樣拿起杯來，說：這杯是用我的血所立的新約，你們每逢喝的時候，要如此行，為的是記念我。
en: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me.” In the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, whenever you drink it, in remembrance of me.”

zh: 感謝神，使我們藉著我們的主耶穌基督得勝。所以，我親愛的弟兄們，你們務要堅固，不可搖動，常常竭力多做主工；因為知道，你們的勞苦在主裡面不是徒然的。
en: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ. Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

zh: 感謝神，因他有說不盡的恩賜。
en: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!

zh: 你們得救是本乎恩，也因著信；這並不是出於自己，乃是神所賜的；也不是出於行為，免得有人自誇。我們原是他的工作，在基督耶穌裡造成的，為要叫我們行善，就是神所預備叫我們行的。
en: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God— not by works, so that no one can boast. For we are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

zh: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌、彼此對說，口唱心和的讚美主。凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常常感謝父神。
en: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music from your heart to the Lord, always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

zh: 願恩惠、平安從神我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們！我每逢想念你們，就感謝我的神。
en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Thanksgiving and Prayer I thank my God every time I remember you.

zh: 又要叫基督的平安在你們心裡作主；你們也為此蒙召，歸為一體；且要存感謝的心。當用各樣的智慧，把基督的道理豐豐富富的存在心裡,用詩章、頌詞、靈歌，彼此教導，互相勸戒，心被恩感，歌頌神。無論做甚麼，或說話或行事，都要奉主耶穌的名，藉著他感謝父神。
en: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful. Let the message of Christ dwell among you richly as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit, singing to God with gratitude in your hearts. And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

zh: 我們為你們眾人常常感謝神，禱告的時候提到你們，在神我們的父面前，不住的記念你們因信心所做的工夫，因愛心所受的勞苦，因盼望我們主耶穌基督所存的忍耐。
en: Thanksgiving for the Thessalonians’ Faith We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers. We remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

zh: 為此，我們也不住的感謝神，因你們聽見我們所傳神的道就領受了；不以為是人的道，乃以為是神的道。這道實在是神的，並且運行在你們信主的人心中。
en: And we also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word, but as it actually is, the word of God, which is indeed at work in you who believe.

zh: 要常常喜樂，不住的禱告，凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裡向你們所定的旨意。
en: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

zh: 主所愛的弟兄們哪，我們本該常為你們感謝神；因為他從起初揀選了你們，叫你們因信真道，又被聖靈感動，成為聖潔，能以得救。
en: Stand Firm But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit and through belief in the truth.

zh: 然而，敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了；因為我們沒有帶甚麼到世上來，也不能帶甚麼去。只要有衣有食，就當知足。
en: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it. But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.

zh: 起初，神創造天地。地是空虛混沌，淵面黑暗；神的靈運行在水面上。
en: The Beginning 1 In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.

zh: 神說：我們要照著我們的形像、按著我們的樣式造人，使他們管理海裡的魚、空中的鳥、地上的牲畜，和全地，並地上所爬的一切昆蟲。
en: Then God said, “Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky, over the livestock and all the wild animals, and over all the creatures that move along the ground.”

zh: 聖經都是神所默示的，於教訓、督責、使人歸正、教導人學義都是有益的，叫屬神的人得以完全，預備行各樣的善事。
en: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness, so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.

zh: 因有一嬰孩為我們而生；有一子賜給我們。政權必擔在他的肩頭上；他名稱為奇妙策士、全能的神、永在的父、和平的君。
en: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

zh: 神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，叫一切信他的，不至滅亡，反得永生。
en: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

zh: 耶穌說我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。
en: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

zh: 彼得說：你們各人要悔改，奉耶穌基督的名受洗，叫你們的罪得赦，就必領受所賜的聖靈。
en: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

zh: 聖靈所結的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信實、溫柔、節制。這樣的事沒有律法禁止。
en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

zh: 親愛的弟兄阿，我們應當彼此相愛，因為愛是從神來的。凡有愛心的，都是由神而生，並且認識神。沒有愛心的，就不認識神，因為神就是愛。
en: God’s Love and Ours Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

zh: 愛是恆久忍耐，又有恩慈；愛是不嫉妒；愛是不自誇，不張狂，不做害羞的事，不求自己的益處，不輕易發怒，不計算人的惡，不喜歡不義，只喜歡真理；凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。愛是永不止息。
en: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud. It does not dishonor others, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs. Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth. It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres. Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

zh: 我們一生的年日是七十歲，若是強壯可到八十歲；但其中所矜誇的不過是勞苦愁煩，轉眼成空，我們便如飛而去。
en: Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

zh: 白髮是榮耀的冠冕，在公義的道上必能得著。不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士；治服己心的，強如取城。籤放在懷裡，定事由耶和華。
en: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained in the way of righteousness. Better a patient person than a warrior, one with self-control than one who takes a city. The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the Lord.

zh: 你們要先求他的國和他的義，這些東西都要加給你們了。所以，不要為明天憂慮，因為明天自有明天的憂慮；一天的難處一天當就夠了。
en: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well. Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

zh: 這世界和其上的情慾都要過去，惟獨遵行神旨意的，是永遠常存。
en: The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.

zh: 神啊，求你按你的慈愛憐恤我！按你豐盛的慈悲塗抹我的過犯！求你將我的罪孽洗除淨盡，並潔除我的罪！因為，我知道我的過犯；我的罪常在我面前。
en: Psalm 51 For the director of music. A psalm of David. When the prophet Nathan came to him after David had committed adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions. Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin. For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

zh: 人若知道行善，卻不去行，這就是他的罪了。
en: If anyone, then, knows the good they ought to do and doesn’t do it, it is sin for them.

zh: 我們若認自己的罪，神是信實的，是公義的，必要赦免我們的罪，洗淨我們一切的不義。我們若說自己沒有犯過罪，便是以神為說謊的，他的道也不在我們心裡了。
en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and purify us from all unrighteousness. If we claim we have not sinned, we make him out to be a liar and his word is not in us.

zh: 我要歌唱耶和華的慈愛，直到永遠；我要用口將你的信實傳與萬代。因我曾說：你的慈悲必建立到永遠；你的信實必堅立在天上。
en: Psalm 89 A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the Lord’s great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations. I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

zh: 不要以惡報惡；眾人以為美的事要留心去做。若是能行，總要盡力與眾人和睦。
en: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everyone. If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

zh: 惟獨從上頭來的智慧，先是清潔，後是和平，溫良柔順，滿有憐憫，多結善果，沒有偏見，沒有假冒。並且使人和平的，是用和平所栽種的義果。
en: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere. Peacemakers who sow in peace reap a harvest of righteousness.

zh: 他苦煉你，任你飢餓，將你和你列祖所不認識的嗎哪賜給你吃，使你知道，人活著不是單靠食物，乃是靠耶和華口裡所出的一切話。
en: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your ancestors had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord.

zh: 美名勝過大財；恩寵強如金銀。富戶窮人在世相遇，都為耶和華所造。通達人見禍藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。敬畏耶和華心存謙卑，就得富有、尊榮、生命為賞賜。
en: 22 A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold. Rich and poor have this in common: The Lord is the Maker of them all. The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty. Humility is the fear of the Lord; its wages are riches and honor and life.

zh: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裡來，我就使你們得安息。我心裡柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裡就必得享安息。因為我的軛是容易的，我的擔子是輕省的。
en: “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”

zh: 但願使人有盼望的神，因信將諸般的喜樂、平安充滿你們的心，使你們藉著聖靈的能力大有盼望。
en: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

zh: 應當一無罣慮，只要凡事藉著禱告、祈求，和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。神所賜、出人意外的平安必在基督耶穌裡保守你們的心懷意念。
en: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

zh: 要常常喜樂，不住的禱告，凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裡向你們所定的旨意。
en: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

zh: 你禱告的時候，要進你的內屋，關上門，禱告你在暗中的父；你父在暗中察看，必然報答你。
en: But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

zh: 我又告訴你們，若是你們中間有兩個人在地上同心合意的求甚麼事，我在天上的父必為他們成全。因為無論在那裡，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裡就有我在他們中間。
en: “Again, truly I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask for, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven. For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.”

zh: 我勸你，第一要為萬人懇求、禱告、代求、祝謝；為君王和一切在位的，也該如此，使我們可以敬虔、端正、平安無事的度日。
en: Instructions on Worship 2 I urge, then, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for all people— for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.

zh: 當用詩章、頌詞、靈歌、彼此對說，口唱心和的讚美主。凡事要奉我們主耶穌基督的名常常感謝父神。
en: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music from your heart to the Lord, always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

zh: 然而，敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了；因為我們沒有帶甚麼到世上來，也不能帶甚麼去。只要有衣有食，就當知足。
en: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it. But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.
